name: Makhana Chatpati Imli
ingredients: Makhana (Fox Nut) 62%, Edible vegetable oil (Olive Oil) 22%, Spices and Condiments 9% (Red Chili Powder, Clove, Cumin, Black Peper Ginger), Black Salt, Rock Salt, Tamarind Powder, Sugar, Dry Mango Powder, Lemon Juice Powder, Asafoetida Powder, Natural and Nature identical flavours.
